name: Slow Burn
source:
You dream of becoming a world famous chef, but that's not your reality, until one chance encounter changes everything. Will you be able to prove yourself? Or will it all go up in flames?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Slow_Burn]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你梦想成为一名世界著名厨师，但这不是你的现实，直到一次偶然的邂逅改变了一切。你能证明自己吗？还是一切都将化为灰烬？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Slow_Burn]Choices Wikia[/url]]
